title: Gelbe Seiten Business Scraper
description: Extract public German business listings from Gelbe Seiten by business type and location, or from existing Gelbe Seiten search and business URLs.

searches.title: Business searches
searches.description: Business-type and location pairs to search on Gelbe Seiten. Example: [{"query":"Zahnarzt","location":"Berlin"}]. Defaults to a Berlin dentist search. This is not a list of URLs; use Gelbe Seiten URLs for an existing results or business page.

query.title: Business type
query.description: Business type or service to find, for example 'Zahnarzt' or 'Steuerberater'.

location.title: Location
location.description: German city, district, or postal code, for example 'Berlin' or '10115'.

startUrls.title: Gelbe Seiten URLs
startUrls.description: Existing Gelbe Seiten search-result or business-detail URLs. Example: https://www.gelbeseiten.de/branchen/zahnarzt/berlin. Use this to preserve a search URL's filters; URLs outside gelbeseiten.de are rejected.

maxResults.title: Maximum businesses
maxResults.description: Maximum unique business records to return across every input. Example: 50. Defaults to 50 and accepts 1 through 500. This is a business-row cap, not a page count, and it also caps billable business-found events.

enrichDetails.title: Enrich business details
enrichDetails.description: VibeLeads scope: keep optional contact/detail extraction explicitly disabled during company discovery. A relevant stage for named qualified businesses requires verified actual build controls, source/use rights and suppression under the contact-use gate. Decline inseparable audience collection.
enrichDetails.x-vibeleads-discovery: explicitly disabled; verify actual build, otherwise decline route

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
x-vibeleads-contact-use-review: required; company discovery and contact stages are distinct
